categories.title: Chem Fluid
categories.info:
Versatile crafting material. Can be used to make:
- First Aid Meds ([Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12384) + [Herb](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12383))
- Handgun Bullets x10 ([Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12384) + [Gunpowder](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12387))
- Burner Fuel x100 ([Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12384) + [Solid Fuel](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12393))
    - First Aid Meds ([Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/end-of-zoe?search=category:12384) + [Critter](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/end-of-zoe?search=category:12396)) (End of Zoe DLC)
    - Stake Bombs ([Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/end-of-zoe?search=category:12384) + [Tree Branches](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/end-of-zoe?search=category:12395)) (End of Zoe DLC)

categories.title: Critter
categories.info:
Crafting material that can be consumed as-is to regain health.
- First Aid Med ([Critter](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/end-of-zoe?search=category:12396) + [Chem Fluid](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/end-of-zoe?search=category:12384))
